newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Telstra to spend A$12 bln in 3 yrs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Telstra to spend A$12 bln in 3 yrs.

text.p: Australian government-owned telecommunications carrier Telstra Corp said on Wednesday it planned to spend A$12 billion over the next three years on new product development and upgrading its existing facilities.

"We plan to spend A$12 billion over the next three years on new product development and for upgrading our communication facilities," said Dough Campbell, group managing director of Teltra's network and technology group.
Campbell said that Telstra had spent A$3.1 billion in 1995/96. He said the company was on target to spend A$20 billion on its current five year capital expenditure programme which commenced in 1992.
Campbell was speaking at an Australian Telecommunications conference in Sydney.
